The '''Library of Silversisi''' was an ancient [[Library/Legends|library]] that shared its name with the [[Silversisi system/Legends|Silversisi system]]. It was mentioned by [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] in his manuscript, ''[[The Science of Creating Life]]''. Plagueis mused that [[Flow-walking]] could be useful in viewing the long-lost secrets that this library contained, as well as the library itself.<ref name="BookSith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>
